test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 9.
solution:
The correct answer is 'fight.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***He looked upon the ___(9)___ against hydrophobia as a battle****...*'' is indicating doing something against hydrophobia as a battle.
 
• The use of the word ''battle'' in the sentence indicates **a lengthy and difficult conflict or struggle**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'fight'.
 
• The word 'fight' means **to try very hard to stop or prevent something**. 
 
 
• Example:* Scientists are claiming a major breakthrough in the **fight** against cancer*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: *He looked upon the **fight** against hydrophobia as a battle...*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Scuffle' means **a short, not very violent fight**. (हाथापाई, हाथाबाँही, झिड़प)
 
• 'Mutiny' means **refusing to obey the orders of a person in authority**. (विद्रोह होना या करना)
 
• 'Rivalry' means **competition between people, groups, etc**. (प्रतिद्वंद्वित, प्रतिस्‍पर्धा)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*He looked upon the ___(9)___ against hydrophobia as a battle**...*'' एक लड़ाई के रूप में हाइड्रोफोबिया के खिलाफ कुछ करने का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में ''battle'' शब्द का प्रयोग, एक लंबा और कठिन संघर्ष, का संकेत करता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'fight' है।
 
• 'Fight' शब्द का अर्थ है **कुछ रोकने का ज़ोरदार प्रयास करना**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Scientists are claiming a major breakthrough in the fight against cancer*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *He looked upon the fight against hydrophobia as a battle...*
